step1.heading: Connect an empty IG account to 2Tag
step1.bullet1: Use the account to follow about 10 creators in your niche or area.
step1.bullet2: Add this account as an Insta-bot in "Accounts"
step1.footer: We value your privacy, so please refrain from using your active account as the Instagram bot.

step2.heading: Input a 5-8 word-prompt
step2.bullet1: In a few words, tell us in text what your content is about.
step2.bullet2: AI companion will analyze and customize the most relevant hashtag trends for your consideration.
step2.footer: Tell us again in another few words and let us work for you again if results are not satisfied.

step3.heading: Generate Trending Hashtag
step3.bullet1: Save or choose hashtag trends based on relevance i.e. 80%, 90%, 95% etc. visibility.
step3.bullet2: Ready to use to grow more impressions and reaches
